experiment: PANNs Cnn14_16k frozen embedding plus fixed logistic regression
status_at_write: Frozen before any new embedding extraction or fitted-head results
question: Does a fixed externally pretrained audio representation plus a linear head outperform the existing channel-attention reference on the same development-validation clips?

encoder.embedding: model output_dict['embedding'], 2048 features, post fc1 ReLU, eval mode

head.preprocessing: StandardScaler fit on training embeddings only

primary_metric: 100 * (PANNs clip accuracy minus mean clip accuracy of the three existing fixed channel-attention fits)
threshold_interpretation: A practical screen only, not a statistical theorem or independent confirmation
secondary_outputs: paired differences versus CNN and BiGRU
paired repairs and new errors versus each reference fit
stopping_rule: Stop after the fixed extraction, fit and evaluation regardless of score. Preserve failures; resolve implementation errors without tuning on validation accuracy.
limitations: All official folds have historical development exposure
AudioSet and ESC-50 overlap is not comprehensively excluded
External pretraining, encoder capacity and frontend differ from scratch-trained references; this is a system comparison, not an attention-only causal effect
Source-bootstrap uncertainty conditions on these fixed fits
Not a standard five-fold ESC-50 benchmark or untouched-test result
